escalations.title: Handlebars.js Multiple Critical CVEs via ts-jest (Build Pipeline)
escalations.finding_summary: Handlebars ≤4.7.8 carries CVSS 9.8 JavaScript injection CVEs in Source/Backend build chain via ts-jest@29.x — dev-time only currently, but requires security validation

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ and platform/
p2_findings.detail: Enforcer hardcodes source_dirs = ['Source', 'E2E']. portal/ and platform/ are invisible — 76 false-negative warnings, real gaps go undetected.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add 'portal' and 'platform' to source_dirs in check_traceability(). One-line fix.

p2_findings.title: Direct DB queries in teamDispatches route handler
p2_findings.detail: Route calls db.prepare(...).all() and db.prepare(...).run() directly — no service layer. CLAUDE.md: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract teamDispatchService.ts with listDispatches(db) and createDispatch(db). Move TeamDispatch to portal/Shared/types.ts.

p2_findings.title: Vitest CVE cascade from outdated vite dependency chain

p3_findings.title: 3 empty .catch(() => {}) blocks swallow errors silently
p3_findings.recommendation: Replace with catch((err) => { logger.error('...', err); }) or surface error toast. If intentional, add comment.

p3_findings.title: 3 production files with zero Verifies comments (incl. unspecced feature)
p3_findings.recommendation: Write spec entries in Plans/ for team-dispatches API and Teams page. Backfill // Verifies: comments.

p3_findings.title: FR-DUP-06 missing Verifies comment
p3_findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-DUP-06 to the /:id GET handlers in bugs.ts and featureRequests.ts.

p3_findings.title: Inline TeamDispatch type defined in route file
p3_findings.recommendation: Move TeamDispatch interface to portal/Shared/types.ts and import from there.

p3_findings.title: FR-070 to FR-095 not backported to Specifications/
p3_findings.recommendation: Append FR-070-095 and FR-DUP-* to Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md. Documentation only.

p3_findings.recommendation: Plan Express v5 migration (breaking: async error handling). Patch to 4.22.1 first as intermediate step.

p3_findings.title: pino@8.17.0 — 2 major versions behind (latest 10.3.1)
p3_findings.recommendation: Update to pino@8.21+ (patch) first, then plan v9/v10 migration.

p3_findings.title: React ecosystem 1 major behind (v18→v19) + react-router-dom v6→v7
p3_findings.recommendation: Plan React 19 migration (breaking: JSX runtime changes). Separate sprint recommended.

p4_findings.title: 2 eslint-disable suppressions without explanatory comments

p4_findings.recommendation: Extract sub-components from detail views; split cycleService into pipeline lifecycle + ticket management.
